Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner treated Wikipedia’s infobox locality “Weston-under-Lizard” as the place of death, instead of the specific estate “Weston Park” (within Weston-under-Lizard) cited by peerage sources and expected by the task. This conflated the parish/town with the precise place of death, steering the solution toward the wrong location.
